biography_summary: 德里克·内尔德纳（Derek Neldner），1973年4月出生，加拿大籍银行高管，现任加拿大皇家银行（RBC）旗下RBC资本市场首席执行官兼集团负责人，并为RBC集团执行委员会成员。Neldner拥有阿尔伯塔大学金融学学士学位，持有CFA特许金融分析师资格。他于1995年加入RBC，在资本市场部门拥有近30年的从业经验，曾担任全球投资银行部负责人，在并购咨询、债务和股权融资等投资银行各领域积累了丰富的专业经验。2019年10月，Neldner被任命为RBC资本市场CEO兼集团负责人，接替退休的Doug McGregor，全面负责RBC在全球范围的企业与投资银行和全球市场业务战略。同时他还担任RBC美国集团控股有限公司董事长兼CEO，协调RBC在美国市场的监管合规与业务发展。在Neldner的领导下，RBC资本市场持续保持全球领先的投资银行地位，并积极参与了RBC对汇丰银行加拿大子公司约135亿加元的收购等重大交易。Neldner积极投身公益事业，担任多伦多病童医院基金会董事和联合劝募运动委员会金融行业主席，并曾任RBC资本市场加拿大多元包容领导力委员会联合主席。他已婚并育有四个子女，居住在加拿大多伦多。

collection_meta.notes: Profile of Derek Neldner, CEO and Group Head of RBC Capital Markets. Born April 1973 (confirmed from UK Companies House / checkcompany.co.uk). Canadian nationality. Education: BCom Finance from University of Alberta; CFA designation from CFA Institute. Joined RBC in 1995, served as Global Head of Investment Banking prior to current role. Appointed CEO and Group Head of RBC Capital Markets effective November 2019, succeeding Doug McGregor. Also serves as Chairman and CEO of RBC US Group Holdings LLC (IHC). Member of RBC Group Executive committee. Annual compensation approximately C$11.71M (per Globe and Mail report). RBC stock holdings: 15,649 shares (~C$3M value). Philanthropy: Board member of SickKids Foundation; United Way Campaign Cabinet Finance Sector Chair (since 2023); University of Alberta School of Business Advisory Council. Co-chaired RBC Capital Markets Canadian Diversity Leadership Council. Married with four children, lives in Toronto. No Wikipedia page. No Wikidata QID.
